description: Ships NO CODE. Declares the Desert Ant Labs Moderator LiteRT artifact and one model-runtime recipe, so the host's declarative lane registers classify_nsfw from data alone.

tools.name: classify_nsfw
tools.description: Check an image for nudity or sexual content on device: per-region scores, an NSFW decision at a threshold, and the policy and quality used.

skills.name: classify-nsfw
skills.description: Use classify_nsfw to screen user-supplied images for adult content on device before storing, publishing or sending them anywhere.
